nota: Events curated by web research on 10 Nov 2026 (window 13 Jul - 10 Nov 2026). Coordinates: the place named by the source, or a distance and bearing from it computed with a great-circle formula; origine_coord "stimata" with an honest radius (precisione_km; over 100 km = report only). ReCAAP items carry the coordinates published by ReCAAP (origine_coord "fonte"). Wikipedia Portal:Current events and List of shipwrecks in 2026 were used as an index to find primary reports; each item links the outlet that reported it. Affidabilita: alta = official agency (UKMTO, CENTCOM, governments, operators) or several outlets; media = single outlet or a party's claim.
